$comment: IA of the GlassFlow clone (src/). Route set = the original's sitemap.xml (108 URLs), every one verified to resolve in the clone. Section lists are derived from the JSX composition in src/pages/*.jsx and src/routes.jsx, in render order. Spacer gap bands (ui.jsx > Spacer) between sections are layout rhythm, not sections, and are omitted. Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs.

meta.source: https://www.glassflow.ai/ (sitemap.xml) as implemented in the local clone
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; compositions read from src/pages/*.jsx, routes from src/routes.jsx

categories.CHROME: Site-wide frame around page content: navigation, the closing CTA band and footer, and the legacy black-design header.
categories.HERO: The opening block of a route, directly under the nav.
categories.PROOF: Third-party credibility: customer and tool logos, quotes, investors, outcome metrics.
categories.PRODUCT: Explanation of what a GlassFlow product does and how it works.
categories.COMPARISON: Competitor-versus-Rius argument blocks on the alternatives pages.
categories.COMMERCE: Plans, prices, add-ons and cost calculators.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is a sign-up, contact, booking or next-page click.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial and informational bodies: blog listings, articles, legal text, company story.

chrome.navbar.description: Main-design top bar: wordmark, products dropdown (tares/rius), docs/blog/contact links, amber get_started CTA whose target changes per route; on mobile a second row of five link cells.
chrome.navbar.scope: Every route that uses the main brown/amber design, i.e. all routes except the redirects and the legacy black-design pages.

chrome.cta-band.description: Three-cell closing band above the footer: an image cell with a closing question headline, then Start with Tares and Start with Rius cells, each with an amber get_started button.
chrome.cta-band.scope: Rendered by the global Footer, so it sits on every main-design route.

chrome.footer.description: Main-design footer: wordmark cell, products block (tares/rius link cards), contact/docs/blog/about link column, X/LinkedIn/GitHub cells, and the legal bar (copyright, Terms, Privacy).

chrome.legacy-nav.description: Older ClickHouse-era black design header: fixed, blurred, with Product/Case Studies/Pricing/Resources/Contact dropdowns, a GitHub star look-alike and a hamburger menu on mobile. These pages have no footer and no CTA band.
chrome.legacy-nav.scope: The 7 live category pages and the 2 ebook guide pages.

hero.home.description: Home opener: full-width dithered Mars image band, then two bordered panels holding the per-word-revealed H1 and the one-line positioning paragraph with the amber get_started button.

hero.product.description: Product-page opener for a single product: badge, appear-animated headline and lead, primary and secondary buttons, and the product imagery.

hero.pricing.description: Rius pricing opener: title bar, pricing headline and intro, and the amber get_started button.

hero.alternative.description: Competitor-alternative opener: 'Rius is an X alternative' headline, one-sentence lead, try-free and talk-to-founders buttons, pricing small print, jump link, dashboard screenshot and a four-chip capability row.

hero.blog-index.description: Blog index title block: page heading with category chip.

hero.post.description: Blog post opener: breadcrumb, per-word-revealed title, description, author/date/category meta row and cover image.

hero.case-studies-index.scope: /case-studies only (the same component is reused lower down on case-study detail pages as content.more-case-studies).

hero.case-study.description: Case-study detail opener: back-to-case-studies chip, customer title and summary, followed by the outcome metrics strip.

hero.about.description: About opener: panel bar with pixel-corner decoration and two appear-animated text blocks introducing the company.

hero.legacy-guide.description: Legacy ebook landing block: amber pill, gradient-text H1, lead, 'What's inside' checklist, device mock-up imagery, and the lead-capture form beside it.

hero.legacy-category.description: Legacy black-design category heading: centred category name.

proof.works-with-strip.description: 'Works with the tools you already use' label cell plus four cream tool logos (Vercel, Claude, Cursor, OpenAI).
proof.works-with-strip.scope: Home, and inside the contact panel on /contact.

proof.testimonial.description: Customer quote block: quote glyph, large quote text, then attribution with avatar, name/role and company tile. Full-width on home, a compact variant on /rius, and a bare inline variant inside case-study bodies.
proof.testimonial.scope: Home, /rius and the 2 case-study detail pages.

proof.customer-logos.description: Rius customer and backer logo row.

proof.alternative-logos.description: Two-half logo block on the alternatives pages: 'Used by' and 'Backed by CEOs of', three logo cells each.

proof.alternative-quote.description: Single customer quote with avatar, name/title and company logo, styled for the alternatives template (it reuses the /rius quote text).

proof.investors.description: Investors and backers grid with title row.

product.tares-feature.description: Two-column Tares product block on home: badge, headline, description and github/learn_more buttons beside the Tares dashboard image.

product.rius-feature.description: Two-column Rius product block on home, mirrored: Rius metrics image beside badge, headline, description and get_started/learn_more buttons.

product.image-card-grid.description: Title row followed by a grid of image cards, each with a screenshot and short caption.

product.tabs-showcase.description: 'What is in Tares' numbered tab accordion: selecting a tab expands its description (0.45s height tween) and swaps the paired image instantly; nothing auto-advances.

product.incident-timeline.description: Heading band plus a log-style incident timeline with one highlighted entry.

product.run-it-terminals.description: 'Run it' block: heading band and two terminal-window cards with commands.

product.benefits-strip.description: Row of short Rius benefit cells directly under the product hero.

product.retrospective.description: Retrospective section built around a Lottie animation of an agent run.

product.agents-length-table.description: 'Agents aren't one length' table comparing short, mid, long and always-on agent runs.

product.what-you-get.description: 'What you get' feature cards, each with an image and short copy.

comparison.vs-table.description: Rius-versus-competitor table of numbered topic rows (detection, root cause, heartbeat, alerts, MCP, user view, limits, price), with the Rius column highlighted. Arize adds a toggle between two competitor products. Collapses to labelled blocks on mobile.

comparison.where-it-stops.description: 'Where X stops' heading and three gap cards, each with a title, a one-liner and three bullets.

comparison.silent-failures.description: Heading on the left and a 2x3 grid of failure-type cards on the right, each with a category kicker, title and one sentence.

comparison.install-steps.description: 'Instrument your agent in 2 minutes': python/typescript tabbed install prompt with a COPY button, three numbered steps and a get-API-key action row.
comparison.install-steps.scope: The Arize alternatives page only (the Langfuse data has no install block).

comparison.feature-splits.description: Repeated image-plus-text split rows, each arguing one Rius capability, with an optional flow line (e.g. symptom→pattern→root cause→alert).
comparison.feature-splits.scope: Both alternatives pages (one or more rows each, from per-vendor data).

comparison.side-by-side.description: Two-panel side-by-side comparison block with paired bars.

comparison.better-pick.description: Numbered 'when each tool is the better pick' guidance block, closing with a primary button.

commerce.plan-cards.description: Rius plan cards (title row plus one card per plan with price, inclusions and CTA).

commerce.pricing-banner.description: Slim banner linking from the plan cards to the full /rius/pricing page.

commerce.comparison-table.description: Full plan-by-feature comparison table with the Growth column highlighted; scrolls sideways on mobile.

commerce.every-plan.description: 'In every plan' list of features included across all tiers.

commerce.add-ons.description: Add-on cards with price and button.

commerce.cost-calculator-embed.description: Interactive 'what does 100k spans per month cost you' calculator: volume strip, controls, and four cost cards (Rius highlighted) with breakdown accordions and a footnote.

commerce.build-vs-buy-calculator.description: Standalone build-versus-buy agent-observability cost calculator: inputs, advanced panel, cost breakdown, savings result and assumptions. Its maths is exported as computeCost().

conversion.quickstart.description: 'From install to first result in minutes' block over a Mars backdrop: two quickstart cards (glassflow-rius, glassflow-tares), each with pitch, three bullets, a docs link and a Start-with button.

conversion.image-cta.description: Closing image-backed CTA block with headline, short line and button.

conversion.calculator-banner.description: Banner pointing from pricing to the build-versus-buy calculator, with an amber button.

conversion.two-products-band.description: 'Two products' closing band pointing to Tares and Rius, with page-family copy variants (posts, cases, pages) and different copy on mobile.
conversion.two-products-band.scope: Content-family routes: /blog, every blog post, the 2 case-study pages, /about and /contact.

conversion.contact-form.description: Contact panel: title bar, signal image panel with the tool logo strip, and the contact form (name, email, company, interest chips, message). It has sending and error states. Submit never posts to the live HubSpot form; it fakes a delay and routes to /contact/success.

conversion.book-call.description: Founders and calendar booking block built on the Quickstart shell, with an outbound cal.com embed.

conversion.contact-success.description: Thank-you panel: title bar, signal image panel, 'Thanks for reaching out!' heading and link rows to next resources.

conversion.legacy-bottom-cta.description: Legacy black-design closing CTA under the category post grid.

content.featured-post.description: Featured post panel at the top of the blog: title bar, chip, title, excerpt and a text-roll read button.

content.blog-filter-bar.description: Category tabs (synced to ?category-2=) plus title search (synced to ?title=). On mobile only the search shows.

content.post-card-grid.description: Grid of all blog post cards. Hovering a card turns the dots into traffic lights, scales the image to 1.1 and darkens the background. There is no pagination.

content.blog-card-row.description: Title row and a short row of blog cards promoting related articles.

content.article-body.description: Article body renderer (h2/h3, paragraphs, lists, images, tables, quotes, code block with Copy). In this clone it renders only the article's heading outline with one-line summaries and a link to the full article on glassflow.ai; full article text is not reproduced.

content.related-posts.description: 'You might also like' row of three fixed post cards.

content.legacy-post-grid.description: Legacy black-design grid of post cards for one category: 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile (the clone fixes the live mobile squeeze).

content.case-study-cards.description: Grid of case-study cards linking to each customer story.

content.case-study-body.description: Two-column case-study body: inline customer quote and the story's heading outline with summaries in the main column, plus a sidebar of customer facts. Full story text is not reproduced; it links to the original.

content.more-case-studies.description: 'You might also like' compact title row plus the case-study card grid, closing a detail page.

content.values.description: Company values panels with title bar and icon per value.

content.team.description: Team grid with photos, names, roles and LinkedIn buttons.

content.discover-more.description: 'Discover more' link cards built on the Quickstart shell, with text-roll buttons.

content.legal-with-toc.description: Legal document layout with a contents sidebar (hover colour fades 0.3s; not sticky) beside numbered sections. Each section shows its heading and a one-line summary, and the page closes with a link to the full text on glassflow.ai.

content.legal-plain.description: Single-column legal page without a sidebar (company/imprint details).

support.faq.description: Main-design FAQ: centred heading panel with pixel-corner decorations, then accordion rows where several can be open at once (200ms height change, icon cell turns amber and flips).

support.alternative-faq.description: 'Common questions' FAQ on the alternatives template: native details rows that are mutually exclusive (opening one closes the rest, shared with the calculator breakdowns), with an arrow square on the right.
